detail: Full summary: Hybrid dense+BM25+RRF is now confirmed as the retrieval pattern in BOTH Zilliz tools (claude-context: BM25 computed inside Milvus via FunctionType.BM25, server-side RRF k=100; memsearch: local Milvus Lite RRF k=60). Strengthens the case for porting BM25+rank-fusion into Twining's retrieval; memsearch proves it runs fully embedded with no server/API.
